'''''Chrono''''' was a popular periodical during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One cover story featured [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
